$comment: Committed §7.4 baseline for the VS Code smoke. Written by hand from a recorded run and compared against by scripts/../run-smoke.mjs on every run. Raw samples are kept, not reduced away: a median whose numbers were discarded cannot be compared with the next one. Update deliberately, in a commit that says which run replaced it and why.

recordedFrom.note: block 13 slice D; five cold editor launches in one session

crossSessionObserved.$comment: A second session of five launches on the same machine, kept because it is the honest spread: activation ranged 2795–6493 ms across sessions while within-session p95 was 3734. The per-run ceilings in the suite are set above the cross-session maximum for that reason; the §7.4 comparison is against the medians above.
